verdict.rationale: Cognee documents four core operations mapping directly to add/search/update/delete memory (.remember, .recall, .improve, .forget), plus session-based short-term memory and a unified API/CLI/MCP server so an agent can invoke these itself as tools mid-conversation (docs-6/21/34 confirm MCP tool access for agents like Claude/Cursor/Cline). Forget supports single-item, dataset, and full cleanup deletion, and improve is explicitly recommended for use 'at the end of a chat or agent session' to bridge memory. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of an agent actually invoking these tools autonomously mid-conversation (only vendor docs), and no example agent transcript demonstrating live add/search/update/delete cycles.
